operation.description:
Read operation. Retrieve all required pages before reporting complete totals. Returns a paginated list of the account's **estimates** (quotes), most recent first.

The list supports filtering and sorting through the query parameters below. Each item is returned under an `Estimate` member with the estimate header and its client; see **GET Single Estimate** for the full field reference.

Requires permission to view estimates. A user with only the "view his own estimates" permission (and not "view all estimates") sees only estimates they created or are the sales person for.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Response format extension, e.g. `.json`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number to return. Defaults to 1.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of records per page. Defaults to the list default (20).

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Keyword search across the client name, client number, client email, and the estimate number.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Filter by client id.

parameters.name: client_type
parameters.description: Filter by client type (individual or business).

parameters.name: no
parameters.description: Filter by estimate number (partial match).

parameters.name: item
parameters.description: Return estimates that contain a matching item (name/description).

parameters.name: currency_code
parameters.description: Filter by currency code (for example, USD).

parameters.name: payment_status
parameters.description: Filter by estimate status. Pass `-1` to return only **draft** estimates; any other non-empty status id returns only issued (non-draft) estimates with that status.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Filter by tag id(s).

parameters.name: order_source_id
parameters.description: Filter by order source id.

parameters.name: work_order_id
parameters.description: Filter by linked work-order id. Available with the Work Orders / Workflow plugin.

parameters.name: staff_id
parameters.description: Filter by the staff member who created the estimate. Available with the Staff plugin and view-all permission.

parameters.name: sales_person_id
parameters.description: Filter by sales person. Available with the Staff plugin and view-all permission.

parameters.name: summary_total_from
parameters.description: Return estimates whose total is at least this amount.

parameters.name: summary_total_to
parameters.description: Return estimates whose total is at most this amount.

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: Estimate date range start (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: Estimate date range end (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: created_from
parameters.description: Created-date range start (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: created_to
parameters.description: Created-date range end (YYYY-MM-DD).

data.description: Estimates, most recent first. Each item carries an `Estimate` member with the estimate header and its client.

Estimate.description: Estimate header. See GET Single Estimate for the full field reference.

prev.description: URL of the previous page, or null on the first page.

next.description: URL of the next page, or null on the last page.

403.description: The authenticated user lacks permission to view estimates.
